## Committees and boards

- Elected member of the Faculty Board (permanent doctoral staff) and of its Standing Committee.
- Member of the committees that designed the faculty's map of degrees, and of the Physics degree studies committee.
- Member of the support group for the faculty's strategic plan; member of the quality assurance committee; member of the KOORDINA and EKOSCAN improvement groups.
- Boards: doctoral thesis tribunals, master's thesis tribunals, at least three bachelor's thesis tribunals every year since 2011, university entrance examination boards, and hiring boards for the department.

## Editorial and refereeing

Associate editor of *Energies* (MDPI). Reviewer for *Journal of Solid State Chemistry*, *Materials Chemistry and Physics*, the *Physical Review* journals and *Reviews of Modern Physics*, *Journal of Alloys and Compounds*, *Zeitschrift für Kristallographie* and *Physical Chemistry of Materials*.
